note: Reflex policy pack: startup-default, a general starting point for a small team. Copy it with `reflex policy init --pack startup-default`, then commit .reflex/policy.json. It only adds checks. deny rules block in every mode; ask rules go to a human, and in the autonomous profile never to System 2. Patterns are case-insensitive and read the command plus its context (aws_profile=, kube_context=, tf_workspace=, git_branch=, cwd=). The prod markers treat AWS profiles, kube contexts and Terraform workspaces with names that contain prod as a separate part (prod, prod-eu, acme-prod, production, prod01, cluster/prod-eu; not nonprod) as production. The freeze asks before production changes on Friday after 16:00 UTC; change the time zone to yours. After a shadow period, add "mode": "enforce" to make enforce the floor for everyone in this repository.

rules.rule: drops a database, schema or table
rules.note: deny: blocked in every mode, whatever the agent says. It reads the whole command, so the phrase in any argument (an echo, a file name) matches too.
ask: the rows are gone, the table stays.
ask: a human confirms, and in the autonomous profile it never goes to System 2.
deny: delete a repository in the GitHub settings, by hand.
ask: rewrites a shared branch. A force push to main is already denied by the bundled rules.

rules.rule: publishes a package or a container image
rules.note: ask: a published version cannot always be taken back.

rules.rule: changes GitHub secrets, releases or repository settings
rules.note: ask: these reach CI and every user of the repository.

rules.rule: deploys or changes a hosted app
rules.note: ask: vercel and netlify deploys with --prod, every fly deploy (fly has no production flag), and heroku rollback, scale, database reset and app destroy.

always_human.rule: calls a billing or payments CLI
always_human.note: never approved by System 2 in the autonomous profile, always a human

freeze.note: no production changes late on Friday without a human
